hypothesis: With a common from-scratch PPO curriculum and equal total sample budget, doubling only goal_progress from 20 to 40 will improve success rate or final distance.
initialization: Random actor and critic with an empty Adam for every run. Same training seed pairs the random initial weights across conditions; different seeds have different initial weights. Frozen pretrained locomotion is shared. No pretrained transport policy or demonstrations.
checkpoint_selection: Only checkpoints evaluated in the last full_task curriculum phase are eligible. Select using the fixed validation ordering: worst goal-direction sector, worst position/heading cell, worst heading sector, worst position sector, total successes, mean distance. Never use held-out evaluation for selection.
report_uncertainty: Mean and sample SD over three independent from-scratch training seeds; common held-out layouts and paired random initialization within each seed. Report every seed and paired difference.

development.decision: Use more training samples, reduce the full-task learning rate to 3e-5, and select only final-phase checkpoints by validation before held-out evaluation.

hardware_note: Both GPUs are RTX A6000. GPU 1 has an unrelated workload. Training times include all curriculum phases and periodic validation, exclude installation and post-training held-out evaluation, and are not Colab T4 benchmarks.
